description: This file defines an API endpoint class in PHP for managing employee job details within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating an employee's job details via RESTful API, along with validation rules and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeJobDetailAPI
classes.description: An API endpoint class providing methods to retrieve and update employee job details in the OrangeHRM system, including validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific employee's job details based on employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, ensuring the employee number is accessible.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an employee's job details using data provided in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update request, including optional fields and access control.
